Pro's:

  • Its a universe on an unbelievable scale.

Pro/Con:

  • It's as far to the "single player" side of MMO as you can get. The war/faction mechanics are a blast, but you won't be finding a team to go kill a monster with.

Con:

  • They listened to the "harder is better" crowd, and that turned a lot of it into a grind. You'll easily burn through 50 or 60 hours just to get into the best ship for your purpose. Want to explore? Tough, you need to earn money first. Lots of money. I mean technically you could explore in your noob ship but then exploration itself will be a grind. Want to mine?
